'''2008 Worlds Team S Willis DS Incomplete''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[S Willis]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Informal notebook. Team BOBA-FETT-BUNCH, Cape Elizabeth, date 10-12-08. Main deck largely illegible due to bleed-through; shields transcribed from front; side inferred Dark from shield pool. Incomplete transcription.
